name: AWeber
summary: Email marketing and automation for small businesses and creators: drag-and-drop newsletters, prompt-built landing pages, autoresponders and sign-up forms, AI writing help, and since August 2026 a ChatGPT plugin and Claude connector that read a whole automation back with its engagement numbers.
best_for: small businesses and creators who want reliable, simple email marketing with a genuinely usable free tier
skip_if: you need advanced, behaviour-driven automation — newer tools go deeper for the money
honest_knock: The free and low tiers are generous, but Lite and Plus prices climb with your subscriber count, so budget for growth. It's a dependable, no-frills veteran — just not the most modern automation on the market.

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: (re-verified 1 Oct 2026) A free plan still exists (up to 500 subscribers, 3,000 emails a month) but it is reached through the separate free-signup page, not the pricing page; Lite shows $12.49/mo and Plus $19.99/mo at 500 subs (annual billing; both scale by subscriber count). The ~$899 flat Unlimited tier is served to about one visitor in eighteen rather than withdrawn: on 5 Sep 2026 we loaded the pricing page 18 times in fresh cookie-less browsers, 17 returned Lite and Plus with no flat tier and one returned a three-card variant with “Go Unlimited” at $899/mo for unlimited subscribers, so it exists but you cannot count on seeing it. AWeber runs aggressive limited-time launch promos (an ‘87% off’ banner striking $599 to $79 at research time) — treat banner prices as promos, not list prices. AWeber's own affiliate newsletter of 5 September 2026 describes a single paid plan, 'AWeber Pro', starting at $16.15 a month billed annually, and does not name Lite or Plus at all; the pricing page served us Lite and Plus the same day, so the plan names appear to be mid-change. Check the live page before quoting a tier name. Re-checked 6 September 2026 in twelve cookie-less loads: the pricing page named Free, Lite, Plus and Unlimited on all six of its loads, so the flat Unlimited tier that showed once in eighteen loads the day before was served every time; the free-email-marketing page named only Free. No load carried a plan called Pro and the newsletter figure of $16.15 appeared nowhere; the entry amounts read $12.50 and $20.00. Read again on 9 October 2026: the pricing page shows Lite and Plus, plus 'Done For You' (Plus with a setup fee shown as $599 struck to $79), with a Monthly/Annually switch and a subscriber slider. Lite billed monthly: $15 up to 500, $25 up to 1,000, $35 up to 2,500, $60 up to 5,000, $85 up to 7,500, $100 up to 10,000, $150 up to 15,000, $185 up to 20,000, $210 up to 25,000, $275 up to 35,000, $375 up to 50,000, $500 up to 75,000, $600 up to 100,000, $920 up to 150,000 subscribers; billed annually, per month: $12.50, $20.83, $29.17, $50.00, $70.83, $83.33, $125.00, $154.17, $175.00, $229.17, $312.50, $416.67, $500.00, $766.67. Plus billed monthly: $30, $45, $55, $90, $120, $135, $180, $215, $250, $350, $400, $600, $750, $1,050; billed annually, per month: $20.00, $37.50, $45.83, $75.00, $100.00, $112.50, $150.00, $179.17, $208.33, $291.67, $333.33, $500.00, $625.00, $875.00.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 29 October 2026 on AWeber Free: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We tried to import two made-up subscribers from a CSV and opened the Lite trial checkout without paying. AWeber refused both test addresses, so we stopped there.
findings: AWeber rejected both of our made-up addresses (on the reserved test domain example.com) as 'Blocked or invalid email format', so 0 of 2 were added. Following our test plan, we did not swap in real addresses; export and re-import were therefore not tested.

Before the import, AWeber asks how the subscribers joined your list (website, in person, bought a product, purchased the list or other) and whether they come from another provider. The 'Other' answer needs a written explanation.

Confirmation emails for imports are off by default, and the import itself defaults to 'No, they do not need to confirm'. Confirmation for subscribers added through the API is locked on; only AWeber Plus can ask to switch it off.
Custom fields are plain text only, up to 25. The import also offers 'Add new and update existing' and 'Only update existing', with 'Only add new subscribers' preselected.
Our own address was put on our list as a subscriber automatically at signup, and every list needs a postal address, which is printed under your emails.

On Free, 'Invite a user' is disabled ('Upgrade your account to invite more users'). The Lite '14-day trial' goes to a Stripe checkout that asks for a card first: € 13,98 a month from 12 November, nothing due today.
Prices in the app: Lite $15 and Plus $30 a month billed monthly, or $13 and $20 a month billed yearly, which is the preselected option.
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
